style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and info screens, soft sky-blue #4FA8E0 panels with a fine white dot grid for benefit and closing screens, pale blue-grey #EDF2F7 and neutral matte board #F1F4F7 for detail and comparison screens

style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill and soft contact shadows, one warm raking accent only on macro detail shots, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh kids sportswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sky blue #4FA8E0, heather grey #C2C6CB, charcoal text #2E3338 and one warm orange-red accent #E8552F; cool-clean color temperature; bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif headlines and labels in charcoal #2E3338; consistent rounded info labels and numbered circle markers; consistent thin-line icon style; clean childrenswear e-commerce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable scale and placement of the coordinated outfit across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 presentation of the coordinated set with consistent scale and centering across the whole set
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio floor #FFFFFF, pale blue-grey matte board #EDF2F7 and neutral matte board #F1F4F7
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif headlines and labels in charcoal #2E3338
